name: ProgramMd::parse

test_list.description: Parse a documented Markdown front matter and fenced metric block into goal, direction, command, scopes, and positive limits.
Reject a missing or duplicate fenced metric definition without guessing a command.
Reject exact or wildcard-overlapping path scopes, including protected program and metric inputs.
Reject zero wall, token, cost, or experiment limits and numeric overflow.
The immutable program CID changes when any parsed or ignored source byte changes.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: UTF-8 Markdown program bounded to 64 KiB.

output_description: Validated immutable program definition with a content identifier over the original bytes.
